verdict.rationale: ROCm docs explicitly document serving-stack support for this Radeon line (vLLM 'Full support', llama.cpp 'Supported for efficient inference', plus PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX), but there is no mention of low-precision FP8/FP4 inference formats for the RX 9070 XT, and TensorRT-LLM is an NVIDIA-only stack so is not applicable here. Missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 quantization support documentation for this card, independent hands-on benchmarks confirming these serving stacks actually run well on RX 9070 XT.
